subject: ginkgo-cloaked sprite
pose: 叶片一侧掀起，短腿并拢
art_direction: 银杏叶折成宽斗篷小精灵，叶柄是两条短腿，青金与暗紫对照，侧目神态机灵。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design a plant sprite from a single broad ginkgo leaf folded into a fan-shaped cloak. Two short stalk-like legs stand close together beneath it, and a small face sits within a dark central fold. Lift one side of the leaf as if the sprite is listening with a sly glance. Use mustard-gold, slate blue, and plum woodcut-like color blocks, with a few incised vein lines that follow the leaf. Keep the printing edges slightly irregular on cream paper. Avoid a human body, fairy wings, hats, or ornamental floral borders. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
